ar.title: العام مقابل الأساسي: كيف تقرأ تقرير مؤشر أسعار المستهلك القادم ولماذا تشعر باختلاف الأسعار لديك

segments.src: Once a month, usually at 8:30 a.m.
segments.tr: مرة واحدة في الشهر، عادةً في الساعة 8:30 صباحًا

segments.src: Eastern on a weekday around the middle of the month, the U.S.
segments.tr: بتوقيت الشرق في يوم عمل نحو منتصف الشهر، ينشر

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) publishes the Consumer Price Index (CPI).
segments.tr: مكتب إحصاءات العمل الأمريكي (BLS) مؤشر أسعار المستهلك (CPI).

segments.src: Within minutes, headlines announce whether inflation "cooled," "reheated," or "surprised."
segments.tr: وفي غضون دقائق، تعلن العناوين الرئيسية عما إذا كان التضخم قد "هدأ" أو "ارتفع مجددًا" أو "فاجأ الأسواق".

segments.src: Yet many readers look at their own grocery receipts, rent, and gas bills and wonder why the official number doesn't match their experience.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، ينظر العديد من القراء إلى فواتير البقالة والإيجار والبنزين الخاصة بهم ويتساءلون لماذا لا يتطابق الرقم الرسمي مع تجربتهم الفعلية.

segments.src: This guide explains what the CPI measures, how the headline and core readings differ, what each major category contributes, and why your personal inflation rate can differ from the national figure.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا الدليل ما يقيسه مؤشر أسعار المستهلك، وكيف تختلف القراءات العامة عن الأساسية، وما تساهم به كل فئة رئيسية، ولماذا يمكن أن يختلف معدل التضخم الشخصي لديك عن الرقم الوطني.

segments.src: It is educational background, not financial advice.
segments.tr: هذه المادة هي خلفية تعليمية وليست نصيحة مالية.

segments.src: ## Why the CPI Matters
segments.tr: ## لماذا يهم مؤشر أسعار المستهلك

segments.src: The CPI tracks the average change over time in prices paid by urban consumers for a fixed basket of goods and services.
segments.tr: يتتبع مؤشر أسعار المستهلك متوسط التغير بمرور الوقت في الأسعار التي يدفعها المستهلكون في المناطق الحضرية مقابل سلة ثابتة من السلع والخدمات.

segments.src: It feeds into several things that touch daily life:
segments.tr: وهو يؤثر في عدة أمور تمس الحياة اليومية:

segments.src: - **Interest-rate expectations.** The Federal Reserve targets 2% inflation, measured by a related gauge called the PCE price index. Markets still treat the CPI, which arrives earlier, as a key signal for where rates may go. Rates, in turn, influence mortgages, car loans, credit cards, and savings yields.
segments.tr: - **توقعات أسعار الفائدة.** يستهدف الاحتياطي الفيدرالي تضخمًا بنسبة 2%، كما يُقاس بمقياس مرتبط يسمى مؤشر أسعار نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي (PCE). ولا تزال الأسواق تتعامل مع مؤشر أسعار المستهلك، الذي يصدر في وقت أسبق، كإشارة رئيسية للمسار الذي قد تتخذه أسعار الفائدة. وتؤثر أسعار الفائدة بدورها على القروض العقارية، وقروض السيارات، وبطاقات الائتمان، وعوائد المدخرات.

segments.src: - **Social Security cost-of-living adjustments (COLAs).** The annual COLA is based on the CPI-W, a variant covering urban wage earners and clerical workers. It compares the third-quarter average with the prior year's third quarter.
segments.tr: - **تعديلات تكلفة المعيشة (COLAs) للضمان الاجتماعي.** يعتمد تعديل تكلفة المعيشة السنوي على مؤشر CPI-W، وهو متغبر يغطي أصحاب الأجور وموظفي المكاتب في المناطق الحضرية. ويقارن متوسط الربع الثالث بالربع الثالث من العام السابق.

segments.src: - **Wages and contracts.** Some labor agreements, leases, and benefit programs reference CPI changes, and inflation figures shape wage negotiations.
segments.tr: - **الأجور والعقود.** تشير بعض اتفاقيات العمل وعقود الإيجار وبرامج المزايا إلى التغيرات في مؤشر أسعار المستهلك، كما تشكل أرقام التضخم مفاوضات الأجور.

segments.src: - **Tax and program parameters.** Federal income tax brackets and certain benefit thresholds are adjusted each year using a CPI-based measure.
segments.tr: - **معايير الضرائب والبرامج.** يتم تعديل شرائح ضريبة الدخل الفيدرالية وبعض حدود المزايا كل عام باستخدام مقياس يعتمد على مؤشر أسعار المستهلك.

segments.src: ## Headline vs. Core: What's the Difference?
segments.tr: ## العام مقابل الأساسي: ما الفرق؟

segments.src: **Headline CPI** covers everything in the basket.
segments.tr: **مؤشر أسعار المستهلك العام (Headline CPI)** يغطي كل شيء في السلة.

segments.src: **Core CPI** removes food and energy.
segments.tr: **مؤشر أسعار المستهلك الأساسي (Core CPI)** يستبعد الغذاء والطاقة.

segments.src: Those two categories tend to swing sharply because of weather, crop conditions, geopolitical events, and oil-market shifts.
segments.tr: تميل هاتان الفئتان إلى التقلب بشدة بسبب الطقس، وظروف المحاصيل، والأحداث الجيوسياسية، وتحولات سوق النفط.

segments.src: Stripping them out can give a steadier read on underlying trends, which is why many economists and policymakers watch core closely.
segments.tr: ويمكن لاستبعادهما أن يعطي قراءة أكثر استقرارًا للاتجاهات الضمنية، ولهذا السبب يراقب العديد من الاقتصاديين وصناع السياسات المؤشر الأساسي كثب.

segments.src: Core is not "the real inflation" and headline is not "the fake one."
segments.tr: المؤشر الأساسي ليس "التضخم الحقيقي" والمؤشر العام ليس "التضخم الزائف".

segments.src: They answer different questions:
segments.tr: إنهما يجيبان عن سؤالين مختلفين:

segments.src: - Headline asks: *How much more does the typical household's total spending cost?*
segments.tr: - يجيب العام: *كم تبلغ التكلفة الإضافية لإجمالي إنفاق الأسرة النموذجية؟*

segments.src: - Core asks: *Is price pressure broadening and persisting beyond volatile items?*
segments.tr: - يجيب الأساسي: *هل يتسع ضغط الأسعار ويستمر لما هو أبعد من العناصر المتقلبة؟*

segments.src: Food and energy are not optional for most families, so a core reading that looks calm can sit alongside a headline reading that feels painful, and the reverse can also happen.
segments.tr: الغذاء والطاقة ليسا أمرين اختياريين لمعظم الأسر، لذا يمكن لقراءة أساسية تبدو هادئة أن تتزامن مع قراءة عامة تبدو مؤلمة، والعكس صحيح أيضًا.

segments.src: ## The Big Components, One by One
segments.tr: ## المكونات الكبرى، عنصرًا تلو الآخر

segments.src: ### Shelter
segments.tr: ### السكن

segments.src: Shelter is the largest piece of the index, typically around one-third of the overall CPI and a larger share of core.
segments.tr: السكن هو الجزء الأكبر في المؤشر، ويمثل عادة حوالي ثلث إجمالي مؤشر أسعار المستهلك وحصة أكبر من المؤشر الأساسي.

segments.src: It includes rent of primary residences and "owners' equivalent rent" (OER), which estimates what homeowners would pay to rent their own homes.
segments.tr: ويشمل إيجار المساكن الرئيسية و"الإيجار المكافئ للمالكين" (OER)، الذي يقدر ما سيدفعه مالكو المنازل لاستئجار منازلهم الخاصة.

segments.src: It does not directly track home purchase prices or mortgage payments.
segments.tr: ولكنه لا يتتبع بشكل مباشر أسعار شراء المنازل أو مدفوعات القروض العقارية.

segments.src: Two features matter when reading the report:
segments.tr: هناك ميزتان مهمتان عند قراءة التقرير:

segments.src: 1. **Lag.** Rent data are collected from a rotating sample, with each housing unit surveyed only periodically. As a result, the CPI can reflect changes in new-lease market rents months after private rent trackers show them.
segments.tr: 1. **الفجوة الزمنية (Lag).** يتم جمع بيانات الإيجار من عينة دورية، حيث يتم مسح كل وحدة سكنية بشكل دوري فقط. ونتيجة لذلك، يمكن لمؤشر أسعار المستهلك أن يعكس التغيرات في إيجارات السوق للعقود الجديدة بعد أشهر من ظهورها في متتبعات الإيجارات الخاصة.

segments.src: 2. **Weight.** Because shelter is so big, a small monthly change can move core CPI noticeably.
segments.tr: 2. **الوزن النسبي.** نظرًا لأن السكن كبير جدًا، فإن تغييرًا شهريًا صغيرًا يمكن أن يحرك مؤشر أسعار المستهلك الأساسي بشكل ملحوظ.

segments.src: If you rent, your experience may differ from the average, especially if your lease just renewed.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تستأجر، فقد تختلف تجربتك عن المتوسط، خاصة إذا تم تجديد عقد إيجارك مؤخرًا.

segments.src: If you own a home with a fixed-rate mortgage, your housing payment may barely change even while the index's shelter component rises.
segments.tr: وإذا كنت تمتلك منزلاً بقرض عقاري بفائدة ثابتة، فقد تتغير مدفوعات السكن لديك بصعوبة حتى بينما يرتفع مكون السكن في المؤشر.

segments.src: ### Food
segments.tr: ### الغذاء

segments.src: Food is split into "food at home" (groceries) and "food away from home" (restaurants and takeout).
segments.tr: ينقسم الغذاء إلى "الغذاء في المنزل" (البقالة) و"الغذاء خارج المنزل" (المطاعم والوجبات السريعة).

segments.src: Grocery prices can be volatile, driven by weather, animal disease, transportation costs, and global supply.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تكون أسعار البقالة متقلبة، مدفوعة بالطقس، وأمراض الحيوانات، وتكاليف النقل، والإمدادات العالمية.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to move more steadily because they include labor and rent costs.
segments.tr: بينما تميل أسعار المطاعم إلى التحرك بشكل أكثر استقرارًا لأنها تشمل تكاليف العمالة والإيجار.

segments.src: ### Energy
segments.tr: ### الطاقة

segments.src: Energy covers gasoline, electricity, natural gas, and fuel oil.
segments.tr: تغطي الطاقة البنزين والكهرباء والغاز الطبيعي وزيت التدفئة.

segments.src: Gasoline often drives the largest month-to-month swings in headline inflation.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يقود البنزين أكبر التقلبات الشهرية في التضخم العام.

segments.src: A drop at the pump can pull the headline number down even if nothing else has changed, and a spike can do the opposite.
segments.tr: ويمكن لانخفاض أسعاره عند المحطة أن يسحب الرقم العام إلى الأسفل حتى لو لم يتغير أي شيء آخر، ويمكن للارتفاع الحاد أن يفعل العكس.

segments.src: ### Core goods and core services
segments.tr: ### السلع الأساسية والخدمات الأساسية

segments.src: Within core, economists often separate **goods** (cars, furniture, apparel, appliances) from **services** (medical care, insurance, transportation services, recreation, and shelter).
segments.tr: ضمن المؤشر الأساسي، غالبًا ما يفصل الاقتصاديون بين **السلع** (السيارات، الأثاث، الملابس، الأجهزة) و**الخدمات** (الرعاية الطبية، التأمين، خدمات النقل، الترفيه، والسكن).

segments.src: Goods prices respond strongly to supply chains and tariffs, while services tend to be tied to wages and move more slowly.
segments.tr: تستجيب أسعار السلع بشدة لسلاسل التوريد والتعريفات الجمركية، بينما تميل الخدمات إلى الارتباط بالأجور والتحرك بشكل أبطأ.

segments.src: A report in which "supercore" services (core services excluding housing) stays elevated may signal different pressures than one driven by goods.
segments.tr: التقرير الذي تظل فيه خدمات "الخدمات الفائقة" (الخدمات الأساسية باستثناء السكن) مرتفعة قد يشير إلى ضغوط مختلفة عن التقرير المدفوع بالسلع.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report in Five Steps
segments.tr: ## كيف تقرأ التقرير في خمس خطوات

segments.src: 1. **Check the monthly change first.** The monthly figure, seasonally adjusted, shows the latest momentum. The annual (year-over-year) figure covers twelve months and can be influenced by what happened a year ago, a quirk known as the *base effect*.
segments.tr: 1. **تحقق من التغير الشهري أولاً.** يظهر الرقم الشهري، المعدل الفصلي، الزخم الأخير. بينما يغطي الرقم السنوي (على أساس سنوي) اثني عشر شهرًا ويمكن أن يتأثر بما حدث قبل عام، وهي ظاهرة تعرف باسم *تأثير سنة الأساس (base effect)*.

segments.src: 2. **Compare headline and core.** A wide gap usually points to food or energy as the cause.
segments.tr: 2. **قارب بين العام والأساسي.** عادة ما تشير الفجوة الواسعة إلى أن الغذاء أو الطاقة هما السبب.

segments.src: 3. **Look at shelter.** Is it rising or easing, and how much of the core change does it explain?
segments.tr: 3. **انظر إلى السكن.** هل يرتفع أم يهدأ، وكم يفسر من التغير الأساسي؟

segments.src: 4. **Look beyond the headline.** Goods, services excluding shelter, and categories you personally buy tell you more than a single number.
segments.tr: 4. **انظر إلى ما هو أبعد من الرقم العام.** تقدم لك السلع والخدمات باستثناء السكن والفئات التي تشتريها شخصيًا معلومات أكثر من رقم واحد.

segments.src: 5. **Compare with expectations.** Markets react to the gap between the reported figure and forecasts, not just the figure itself. A "hot" or "cool" label usually means above or below the consensus estimate, and the numbers are often revised or rounded in ways that make small misses look bigger than they are.
segments.tr: 5. **قارن مع التوقعات.** تتفاعل الأسواق مع الفجوة بين الرقم المعلن والتوقعات، وليس فقط الرقم نفسه. وغالبًا ما يعني وصف "ساخن" أو "بارد" أنه أعلى أو أقل من تقديرات الإجماع، وغالبًا ما يتم تعديل الأرقام أو تقريبها بطرق تجعل الأخطاء الصغيرة تبدو أكبر مما هي عليه.

segments.src: For a smoother view, some analysts follow alternative measures such as the Cleveland Fed's median and trimmed-mean CPI, which reduce the influence of extreme price moves.
segments.tr: للحصول على رؤية أكثر سلاسة، يتبع بعض المحللين مقاييس بديلة مثل متوسط مؤشر أسعار المستهلك والمعدل المتوسط المخصوم لبنك الاحتياطي الفيدرالي في كليفلاند، والتي تقلل من تأثير تحركات الأسعار المتطرفة.

segments.src: ## Why the Official Number Can Miss What You Pay
segments.tr: ## لماذا قد يغفل الرقم الرسمي عما تدفعه

segments.src: Even a well-built index describes an average that no real household matches exactly.
segments.tr: حتى المؤشر المصمم جيدًا يصف متوسطًا لا تتطابق معه أي أسرة حقيقية تمامًا.

segments.src: Several reasons explain the mismatch:
segments.tr: وتفسر عدة أسباب هذا عدم التطابق:

segments.src: - **Your basket is different.** The CPI weights categories by typical spending. If you commute long distances, have young children, pay for private insurance, or rent in a fast-moving market, your mix may lean toward faster-rising items.
segments.tr: - **سلتك مختلفة.** يزن مؤشر أسعار المستهلك الفئات حسب الإنفاق النموذجي. إذا كنت تتنقل لمسافات طويلة، أو لديك أطفال صغار، أو تدفع مقابل تأمين خاص، أو تستأجر في سوق سريع الحركة، فقد تميل سلتك نحو العناصر الأكثر ارتفاعًا في الأسعار.

segments.src: - **Prices vs. inflation.** Inflation is a rate of change. When inflation slows from, say, a high rate to a lower one, prices are still rising, just more slowly. Price *levels* generally do not fall back, so everyday costs can still feel high long after the annual rate has eased.
segments.tr: - **الأسعار مقابل التضخم.** التضخم هو معدل التغير. عندما يبطؤ التضخم من معدل مرتفع إلى معدل أقل، فإن الأسعار لا تزال ترتفع، ولكن بشكل أبطأ فقط. عمومًا لا تنخفض *مستويات* الأسعار إلى الوراء، لذلك يمكن للتكاليف اليومية أن تظل مرتفعة بعد فترة طويلة من تخفيف المعدل السنوي.

segments.src: - **Frequent purchases loom larger.** People notice gas, eggs, and coffee more than they notice the price of a washing machine bought once every ten years. Frequent, visible purchases shape perception more than their budget share would suggest.
segments.tr: - **المشتريات المتكررة تبدو أكبر.** يلاحظ الناس البنزين والبيض والقهوة أكثر مما يلاحظون سعر غسالة ملابس تشتريها مرة كل عشر سنوات. فالمشتريات المتكررة والمرئية تشكل الانطباع بشكل أكبر مما توحي به حصتها في الميزانية.

segments.src: - **Quality adjustments.** The BLS adjusts prices when product quality changes, such as a phone with a better camera. This is intended to separate pure price changes from improvements, but consumers may not feel they are getting the extra value.
segments.tr: - **تعديلات الجودة.** يعدل مكتب إحصاءات العمل الأسعار عندما تتغير جودة المنتج، مثل هاتف بكاميرا أفضل. ويهدف هذا إلى فصل التغيرات الخالصة في الأسعار عن التحسينات، ولكن قد لا يشعر المستهلكون بأنهم يحصلون على القيمة الإضافية.

segments.src: - **Shrinkflation and substitution.** Smaller packages at the same price are captured in the unit-price data, but the index also assumes consumers shift to alternatives when relative prices change. Not everyone can or wants to switch.
segments.tr: - **انكماش الحجم والاستبدال (Shrinkflation).** يتم التقاط العبوات الأصغر بنفس السعر في بيانات سعر الوحدة، ولكن المؤشر يفترض أيضًا أن المستهلكين يتحولون إلى البدائل عندما تتغير الأسعار النسبية. ولا يستطيع الجميع أو يرغبون في التغيير.

segments.src: - **Regional differences.** National averages mask local conditions. Housing, utilities, and insurance costs vary widely by metro area.
segments.tr: - **الفروق الإقليمية.** تحجب المتوسطات الوطنية الظروف المحلية. فتكاليف السكن والمرافق والتأمين تختلف اختلافًا كبيرًا حسب المنطقة الحضرية.

segments.src: - **Income and wage timing.** If your pay rises slower than prices, you feel the squeeze regardless of what the index says; if it rises faster, the squeeze may feel milder.
segments.tr: - **توقيت الدخل والأجور.** إذا ارتفع راتبك بشكل أبطأ من الأسعار، فستشعر بالضغط بغض النظر عما يقوله المؤشر؛ وإذا ارتفع بشكل أسرع، فقد يبدو الضغط أخف.

segments.src: ## A Practical Way to Build Your Own Inflation Read
segments.tr: ## طريقة عملية لبناء قراءة التضخم الخاصة بك

segments.src: - List your top spending categories and what you paid for each over the past year.
segments.tr: - اكتب قائمة بفئات إنفاقك الرئيسية وما دفعته مقابل كل منها خلال العام الماضي.

segments.src: - Compare those with the matching CPI components, which the BLS publishes in detail, including regional tables.
segments.tr: - قارن تلك الفئات بمكونات مؤشر أسعار المستهلك المطابقة، والتي ينشرها مكتب إحصاءات العمل بالتفصيل، بما في ذلك الجداول الإقليمية.

segments.src: - Note which costs are fixed (a fixed-rate mortgage, a locked lease) and which are exposed (groceries, fuel, insurance renewals).
segments.tr: - حدد التكاليف الثابتة (قرض عقاري بفائدة ثابتة، عقد إيجار محدد) والتكاليف المعرضة للتغير (البقالة، الوقود، تجديدات التأمين).

segments.src: - Use the result for budgeting and for conversations about pay, rather than relying on a single national percentage.
segments.tr: - استخدم النتيجة لوضع الميزانية وللمحادثات حول الأجور، بدلاً من الاعتماد على نسبة مئوية وطنية واحدة.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The CPI is a valuable, carefully constructed tool, but it is an average of a basket, not a bill of your own.
segments.tr: مؤشر أسعار المستهلك هو أداة قيمة ومصممة بعناية، ولكنه متوسط لسلة، وليس فاتورة خاصة بك.

segments.src: Headline inflation tells you how much the full basket moved; core inflation helps you see how persistent the underlying pressure is; and shelter, food, and energy each tell a different part of the story.
segments.tr: يخبرك التضخم العام بمقدار تحرك السلة الكاملة؛ ويساعدك التضخم الأساسي على رؤية مدى استمرار الضغط الضمني؛ بينما يروي كل من السكن والغذاء والطاقة جزءًا مختلفًا من القصة.

segments.src: Reading the next report with those distinctions in mind will help you separate noise from trend, and explain why the data and your wallet sometimes seem to disagree.
segments.tr: ستساعدك قراءة التقرير القادم مع وضع هذه الفروق في الاعتبار على فصل الضوضاء عن الاتجاه العام، وتفسير سبب اختلاف البيانات ومحفظتك في بعض الأحيان.

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) publishes the Consumer Price Index (CPI).
segments.tr: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) des États-Unis publie l'Indice des prix à la consommation (IPC).

segments.src: Within minutes, headlines announce whether inflation "cooled," "reheated," or "surprised."
segments.tr: En quelques minutes, les titres annoncent si l'inflation s'est « refroidie », « réchauffée » ou a « surpris ».

segments.src: Yet many readers look at their own grocery receipts, rent, and gas bills and wonder why the official number doesn't match their experience.
segments.tr: Pourtant, de nombreux lecteurs regardent leurs propres tickets de caisse, leur loyer et leurs factures d'essence et se demandent pourquoi le chiffre officiel ne correspond pas à leur expérience.

segments.src: This guide explains what the CPI measures, how the headline and core readings differ, what each major category contributes, and why your personal inflation rate can differ from the national figure.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique ce que mesure l'IPC, en quoi les mesures globale et sous-jacente diffèrent, ce que chaque grande catégorie apporte, et pourquoi votre taux d'inflation personnel peut différer du chiffre national.

segments.src: It is educational background, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'un contexte éducatif et non d'un conseil financier.

segments.src: ## Why the CPI Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'IPC est important

segments.src: The CPI tracks the average change over time in prices paid by urban consumers for a fixed basket of goods and services.
segments.tr: L'IPC suit l'évolution moyenne dans le temps des prix payés par les consommateurs urbains pour un panier fixe de biens et services.

segments.src: It feeds into several things that touch daily life:
segments.tr: Il alimente plusieurs éléments qui touchent la vie quotidienne :

segments.src: - **Interest-rate expectations.** The Federal Reserve targets 2% inflation, measured by a related gauge called the PCE price index. Markets still treat the CPI, which arrives earlier, as a key signal for where rates may go. Rates, in turn, influence mortgages, car loans, credit cards, and savings yields.
segments.tr: - **Attentes en matière de taux d'intérêt.** La Réserve fédérale vise 2% d'inflation, mesurée par un indicateur connexe appelé l'indice des prix PCE. Les marchés considèrent toujours l'IPC, qui arrive plus tôt, comme un signal clé de l'orientation future des taux. Les taux, à leur tour, influencent les prêts hypothécaires, les prêts automobiles, les cartes de crédit et le rendement de l'épargne.

segments.src: - **Social Security cost-of-living adjustments (COLAs).** The annual COLA is based on the CPI-W, a variant covering urban wage earners and clerical workers. It compares the third-quarter average with the prior year's third quarter.
segments.tr: - **Ajustements du coût de la vie de la Sécurité sociale (COLA).** Le COLA annuel est basé sur l'IPC-W, une variante couvrant les salariés urbains et les employés de bureau. Il compare la moyenne du troisième trimestre à celle du troisième trimestre de l'année précédente.

segments.src: - **Wages and contracts.** Some labor agreements, leases, and benefit programs reference CPI changes, and inflation figures shape wage negotiations.
segments.tr: - **Salaires et contrats.** Certains accords de travail, baux et programmes de prestations se réfèrent aux variations de l'IPC, et les chiffres de l'inflation orientent les négociations salariales.

segments.src: - **Tax and program parameters.** Federal income tax brackets and certain benefit thresholds are adjusted each year using a CPI-based measure.
segments.tr: - **Paramètres fiscaux et des programmes.** Les tranches de l'impôt fédéral sur le revenu et certains seuils de prestations sont ajustés chaque année à l'aide d'une mesure basée sur l'IPC.

segments.src: ## Headline vs. Core: What's the Difference?
segments.tr: ## Global vs Sous-jacent : quelle est la différence ?

segments.src: **Headline CPI** covers everything in the basket.
segments.tr: **L'IPC global** couvre l'ensemble du panier.

segments.src: **Core CPI** removes food and energy.
segments.tr: **L'IPC sous-jacent** exclut l'alimentation et l'énergie.

segments.src: Those two categories tend to swing sharply because of weather, crop conditions, geopolitical events, and oil-market shifts.
segments.tr: Ces deux catégories ont tendance à fluctuer fortement en raison de la météo, des conditions des récoltes, des événements géopolitiques et des évolutions du marché pétrolier.

segments.src: Stripping them out can give a steadier read on underlying trends, which is why many economists and policymakers watch core closely.
segments.tr: Les exclure peut donner une lecture plus stable des tendances sous-jacentes, c'est pourquoi de nombreux économistes et décideurs politiques suivent de près l'indice sous-jacent.

segments.src: Core is not "the real inflation" and headline is not "the fake one."
segments.tr: Le sous-jacent n'est pas « la vraie inflation » et le global n'est pas « la fausse ».

segments.src: They answer different questions:
segments.tr: Ils répondent à des questions différentes :

segments.src: - Headline asks: *How much more does the typical household's total spending cost?*
segments.tr: - L'IPC global demande : *Combien coûtent en plus les dépenses totales du ménage type ?*

segments.src: - Core asks: *Is price pressure broadening and persisting beyond volatile items?*
segments.tr: - L'IPC sous-jacent demande : *La pression sur les prix s'élargit-elle et persiste-t-elle au-delà des postes volatils ?*

segments.src: Food and energy are not optional for most families, so a core reading that looks calm can sit alongside a headline reading that feels painful, and the reverse can also happen.
segments.tr: L'alimentation et l'énergie ne sont pas facultatives pour la plupart des familles, de sorte qu'une lecture sous-jacente d'apparence calme peut côtoyer une lecture globale pénible à vivre, et l'inverse peut également se produire.

segments.src: ## The Big Components, One by One
segments.tr: ## Les composantes majeures, une par une

segments.src: ### Shelter
segments.tr: ### Logement

segments.src: Shelter is the largest piece of the index, typically around one-third of the overall CPI and a larger share of core.
segments.tr: Le logement est la composante la plus importante de l'indice, représentant généralement environ un tiers de l'IPC global et une part encore plus élevée de l'IPC sous-jacent.

segments.src: It includes rent of primary residences and "owners' equivalent rent" (OER), which estimates what homeowners would pay to rent their own homes.
segments.tr: Il comprend le loyer des résidences principales et le « loyer équivalent propriétaire » (OER), qui estime ce que les propriétaires payeraient pour louer leur propre logement.

segments.src: It does not directly track home purchase prices or mortgage payments.
segments.tr: Il ne suit pas directement les prix d'achat des logements ni les mensualités d'emprunt hypothécaire.

segments.src: Two features matter when reading the report:
segments.tr: Deux caractéristiques sont importantes lors de la lecture du rapport :

segments.src: 1. **Lag.** Rent data are collected from a rotating sample, with each housing unit surveyed only periodically. As a result, the CPI can reflect changes in new-lease market rents months after private rent trackers show them.
segments.tr: 1. **Le décalage.** Les données sur les loyers sont collectées à partir d'un échantillon tournant, chaque logement n'étant enquêté que périodiquement. En conséquence, l'IPC peut refléter les variations des loyers des nouveaux baux des mois après que les observateurs privés du marché locatif ne les aient montrées.

segments.src: 2. **Weight.** Because shelter is so big, a small monthly change can move core CPI noticeably.
segments.tr: 2. **Le poids.** Le logement étant une composante majeure, une faible variation mensuelle peut modifier sensiblement l'IPC sous-jacent.

segments.src: If you rent, your experience may differ from the average, especially if your lease just renewed.
segments.tr: Si vous êtes locataire, votre expérience peut différer de la moyenne, surtout si votre bail vient d'être renouvelé.

segments.src: If you own a home with a fixed-rate mortgage, your housing payment may barely change even while the index's shelter component rises.
segments.tr: Si vous êtes propriétaire avec un prêt à taux fixe, votre paiement de logement ne changera presque pas, même si la composante logement de l'indice augmente.

segments.src: ### Food
segments.tr: ### Alimentation

segments.src: Food is split into "food at home" (groceries) and "food away from home" (restaurants and takeout).
segments.tr: L'alimentation se divise en « alimentation à domicile » (courses) et « alimentation hors domicile » (restaurants et plats à emporter).

segments.src: Grocery prices can be volatile, driven by weather, animal disease, transportation costs, and global supply.
segments.tr: Les prix des courses peuvent être volatils, influencés par la météo, les maladies animales, les coûts de transport et l'offre mondiale.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to move more steadily because they include labor and rent costs.
segments.tr: Les prix des restaurants ont tendance à évoluer de manière plus régulière car ils intègrent les coûts de main-d'œuvre et de loyer.

segments.src: ### Energy
segments.tr: ### Énergie

segments.src: Energy covers gasoline, electricity, natural gas, and fuel oil.
segments.tr: L'énergie couvre l'essence, l'électricité, le gaz naturel et le fioul domestique.

segments.src: Gasoline often drives the largest month-to-month swings in headline inflation.
segments.tr: L'essence entraîne souvent les variations mensuelles les plus importantes de l'inflation globale.

segments.src: A drop at the pump can pull the headline number down even if nothing else has changed, and a spike can do the opposite.
segments.tr: Une baisse à la pompe peut faire chuter le chiffre global même si rien d'autre n'a changé, et une hausse peut produire l'effet inverse.

segments.src: ### Core goods and core services
segments.tr: ### Biens et services sous-jacents

segments.src: Within core, economists often separate **goods** (cars, furniture, apparel, appliances) from **services** (medical care, insurance, transportation services, recreation, and shelter).
segments.tr: Au sein de l'IPC sous-jacent, les économistes séparent souvent les **biens** (voitures, meubles, vêtements, appareils électroménagers) des **services** (soins médicaux, assurances, services de transport, loisirs et logement).

segments.src: Goods prices respond strongly to supply chains and tariffs, while services tend to be tied to wages and move more slowly.
segments.tr: Les prix des biens réagissent fortement aux chaînes d'approvisionnement et aux tarifs douaniers, tandis que les services ont tendance à être liés aux salaires et à évoluer plus lentement.

segments.src: A report in which "supercore" services (core services excluding housing) stays elevated may signal different pressures than one driven by goods.
segments.tr: Un rapport dans lequel les services « super sous-jacents » (services sous-jacents hors logement) restent élevés peut signaler des pressions différentes de celui tiré par les biens.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report in Five Steps
segments.tr: ## Comment lire le rapport en cinq étapes

segments.src: 1. **Check the monthly change first.** The monthly figure, seasonally adjusted, shows the latest momentum. The annual (year-over-year) figure covers twelve months and can be influenced by what happened a year ago, a quirk known as the *base effect*.
segments.tr: 1. **Vérifiez d'abord la variation mensuelle.** Le chiffre mensuel, corrigé des variations saisonnières, montre la dynamique la plus récente. Le chiffre annuel (d'une année sur l'autre) couvre douze mois et peut être influencé par ce qui s'est passé il y a un an, une particularité appelée l'*effet de base*.

segments.src: 2. **Compare headline and core.** A wide gap usually points to food or energy as the cause.
segments.tr: 2. **Comparez le global et le sous-jacent.** Un écart important pointe généralement vers l'alimentation ou l'énergie comme cause.

segments.src: 3. **Look at shelter.** Is it rising or easing, and how much of the core change does it explain?
segments.tr: 3. **Regardez le logement.** Est-il en hausse ou en ralentissement, et quelle part de la variation sous-jacente explique-t-il ?

segments.src: 4. **Look beyond the headline.** Goods, services excluding shelter, and categories you personally buy tell you more than a single number.
segments.tr: 4. **Regardez au-delà du chiffre global.** Les biens, les services hors logement et les catégories que vous achetez personnellement vous en apprennent plus qu'un simple chiffre unique.

segments.src: 5. **Compare with expectations.** Markets react to the gap between the reported figure and forecasts, not just the figure itself. A "hot" or "cool" label usually means above or below the consensus estimate, and the numbers are often revised or rounded in ways that make small misses look bigger than they are.
segments.tr: 5. **Comparez aux attentes.** Les marchés réagissent à l'écart entre le chiffre publié et les prévisions, pas seulement au chiffre lui-même. Une étiquette « chaude » ou « froide » signifie généralement supérieure ou inférieure à l'estimation du consensus, et les chiffres sont souvent révisés ou arrondis de manière à faire paraître les petits écarts plus grands qu'ils ne le sont.

segments.src: For a smoother view, some analysts follow alternative measures such as the Cleveland Fed's median and trimmed-mean CPI, which reduce the influence of extreme price moves.
segments.tr: Pour une vue plus lissée, certains analystes suivent des mesures alternatives telles que la médiane de l'IPC et l'IPC moyenné tronqué de la Fed de Cleveland, qui réduisent l'influence des mouvements de prix extrêmes.

segments.src: ## Why the Official Number Can Miss What You Pay
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le chiffre officiel peut ne pas refléter ce que vous payez

segments.src: Even a well-built index describes an average that no real household matches exactly.
segments.tr: Même un indice bien conçu décrit une moyenne à laquelle aucun ménage réel ne correspond exactement.

segments.src: Several reasons explain the mismatch:
segments.tr: Plusieurs raisons expliquent ce décalage :

segments.src: - **Your basket is different.** The CPI weights categories by typical spending. If you commute long distances, have young children, pay for private insurance, or rent in a fast-moving market, your mix may lean toward faster-rising items.
segments.tr: - **Votre panier est différent.** L'IPC pondère les catégories selon les dépenses types. Si vous faites de longs trajets quotidiens, avez de jeunes enfants, payez une assurance privée ou louez sur un marché très dynamique, votre composition peut pencher vers des postes qui augmentent plus vite.

segments.src: - **Prices vs. inflation.** Inflation is a rate of change. When inflation slows from, say, a high rate to a lower one, prices are still rising, just more slowly. Price *levels* generally do not fall back, so everyday costs can still feel high long after the annual rate has eased.
segments.tr: - **Prix vs inflation.** L'inflation est un taux de variation. Lorsque l'inflation ralentit, passant par exemple d'un taux élevé à un taux plus bas, les prix continuent d'augmenter, mais simplement plus lentement. Le *niveau* des prix ne baisse généralement pas, de sorte que les coûts du quotidien peuvent encore sembler élevés longtemps après que le taux annuel s'est modéré.

segments.src: - **Frequent purchases loom larger.** People notice gas, eggs, and coffee more than they notice the price of a washing machine bought once every ten years. Frequent, visible purchases shape perception more than their budget share would suggest.
segments.tr: - **Les achats fréquents pèsent davantage.** Les gens remarquent davantage l'essence, les œufs et le café que le prix d'une machine à laver achetée une fois tous les dix ans. Les achats fréquents et visibles façonnent la perception plus que ne le suggère leur part dans le budget.

segments.src: - **Quality adjustments.** The BLS adjusts prices when product quality changes, such as a phone with a better camera. This is intended to separate pure price changes from improvements, but consumers may not feel they are getting the extra value.
segments.tr: - **Ajustements de qualité.** Le BLS ajuste les prix lorsque la qualité du produit change, comme un téléphone doté d'un meilleur appareil photo. L'objectif est de séparer les pures variations de prix des améliorations, mais les consommateurs n'ont pas toujours l'impression de bénéficier de cette valeur supplémentaire.

segments.src: - **Shrinkflation and substitution.** Smaller packages at the same price are captured in the unit-price data, but the index also assumes consumers shift to alternatives when relative prices change. Not everyone can or wants to switch.
segments.tr: - **Shrinkflation et substitution.** Les emballages plus petits au même prix sont capturés dans les données de prix unitaire, mais l'indice suppose également que les consommateurs se tournent vers des alternatives lorsque les prix relatifs changent. Tout le monde ne peut pas ou ne veut pas changer ses habitudes.

segments.src: - **Regional differences.** National averages mask local conditions. Housing, utilities, and insurance costs vary widely by metro area.
segments.tr: - **Différences régionales.** Les moyennes nationales masquent les conditions locales. Le logement, les services publics et les coûts d'assurance varient considérablement d'une zone métropolitaine à l'autre.

segments.src: - **Income and wage timing.** If your pay rises slower than prices, you feel the squeeze regardless of what the index says; if it rises faster, the squeeze may feel milder.
segments.tr: - **Calendrier des revenus et des salaires.** Si votre salaire augmente plus lentement que les prix, vous ressentez la pression quel que soit le résultat de l'indice ; s'il augmente plus vite, la pression peut sembler plus légère.

segments.src: ## Why the CPI Matters
segments.tr: ## Por Que o CPI Importa

segments.src: The CPI tracks the average change over time in prices paid by urban consumers for a fixed basket of goods and services.
segments.tr: O CPI rastreia a variação média ao longo do tempo nos preços pagos por consumidores urbanos por uma cesta fixa de bens e serviços.

segments.src: It feeds into several things that touch daily life:
segments.tr: Ele alimenta vários fatores que afetam a vida diária:

segments.src: - **Interest-rate expectations.** The Federal Reserve targets 2% inflation, measured by a related gauge called the PCE price index. Markets still treat the CPI, which arrives earlier, as a key signal for where rates may go. Rates, in turn, influence mortgages, car loans, credit cards, and savings yields.
segments.tr: - **Expectativas de taxa de juros.** O Federal Reserve tem como meta uma inflação de 2%, medida por um indicador correlato chamado índice de preços PCE. Os mercados ainda tratam o CPI, que chega antes, como um sinal-chave para onde os juros podem ir. As taxas, por sua vez, influenciam hipotecas, empréstimos de veículos, cartões de crédito e rendimentos de poupança.

segments.src: - **Social Security cost-of-living adjustments (COLAs).** The annual COLA is based on the CPI-W, a variant covering urban wage earners and clerical workers. It compares the third-quarter average with the prior year's third quarter.
segments.tr: - **Ajustes de custo de vida da Previdência Social (COLAs).** O COLA anual é baseado no CPI-W, uma variante que cobre assalariados urbanos e trabalhadores administrativos. Ele compara a média do terceiro trimestre com o terceiro trimestre do ano anterior.

segments.src: - **Wages and contracts.** Some labor agreements, leases, and benefit programs reference CPI changes, and inflation figures shape wage negotiations.
segments.tr: - **Salários e contratos.** Alguns acordos trabalhistas, contratos de aluguel e programas de benefícios utilizam variações do CPI, e os números da inflação moldam as negociações salariais.

segments.src: - **Tax and program parameters.** Federal income tax brackets and certain benefit thresholds are adjusted each year using a CPI-based measure.
segments.tr: - **Parâmetros fiscais e de programas.** As faixas do imposto de renda federal e certos limites de benefícios são ajustados a cada ano usando uma medida baseada no CPI.

segments.src: ## Headline vs. Core: What's the Difference?
segments.tr: ## Geral vs. Núcleo: Qual é a Diferença?

segments.src: **Headline CPI** covers everything in the basket.
segments.tr: O **CPI geral** abrange tudo na cesta.

segments.src: **Core CPI** removes food and energy.
segments.tr: O **núcleo do CPI** remove alimentos e energia.

segments.src: Those two categories tend to swing sharply because of weather, crop conditions, geopolitical events, and oil-market shifts.
segments.tr: Essas duas categorias tendem a oscilar bruscamente devido ao clima, condições das safras, eventos geopolíticos e mudanças no mercado de petróleo.

segments.src: Stripping them out can give a steadier read on underlying trends, which is why many economists and policymakers watch core closely.
segments.tr: Excluí-las pode fornecer uma leitura mais estável das tendências subjacentes, e é por isso que muitos economistas e formuladores de políticas acompanham o núcleo de perto.

segments.src: Core is not "the real inflation" and headline is not "the fake one."
segments.tr: O núcleo não é a "inflação real" e o geral não é o "falso".

segments.src: They answer different questions:
segments.tr: Eles respondem a perguntas diferentes:

segments.src: - Headline asks: *How much more does the typical household's total spending cost?*
segments.tr: - O geral pergunta: *Quanto a mais custa o gasto total da família típica?*

segments.src: - Core asks: *Is price pressure broadening and persisting beyond volatile items?*
segments.tr: - O núcleo pergunta: *A pressão sobre os preços está se ampliando e persistindo além dos itens voláteis?*

segments.src: Food and energy are not optional for most families, so a core reading that looks calm can sit alongside a headline reading that feels painful, and the reverse can also happen.
segments.tr: Alimentação e energia não são opcionais para a maioria das famílias, portanto, uma leitura do núcleo que pareça calma pode coexistir com uma leitura geral que pareça dolorosa, e o inverso também pode acontecer.

segments.src: ## The Big Components, One by One
segments.tr: ## Os Grandes Componentes, Um por Um

segments.src: ### Shelter
segments.tr: ### Habitação (Shelter)

segments.src: Shelter is the largest piece of the index, typically around one-third of the overall CPI and a larger share of core.
segments.tr: A habitação é a maior parte do índice, representando normalmente cerca de um terço do CPI total e uma fatia maior do núcleo.

segments.src: It includes rent of primary residences and "owners' equivalent rent" (OER), which estimates what homeowners would pay to rent their own homes.
segments.tr: Inclui o aluguel de residências primárias e o "aluguel equivalente ao do proprietário" (OER), que estima quanto os proprietários pagariam para alugar suas próprias casas.

segments.src: It does not directly track home purchase prices or mortgage payments.
segments.tr: Ele não rastreia diretamente os preços de compra de imóveis ou pagamentos de hipotecas.

segments.src: Two features matter when reading the report:
segments.tr: Duas características importam ao ler o relatório:

segments.src: 1. **Lag.** Rent data are collected from a rotating sample, with each housing unit surveyed only periodically. As a result, the CPI can reflect changes in new-lease market rents months after private rent trackers show them.
segments.tr: 1. **Defasagem.** Os dados de aluguel são coletados de uma amostra rotativa, com cada unidade habitacional pesquisada apenas periodicamente. Como resultado, o CPI pode refletir mudanças nos aluguéis do mercado de novos contratos meses após os rastreadores privados de aluguel as mostrarem.

segments.src: 2. **Weight.** Because shelter is so big, a small monthly change can move core CPI noticeably.
segments.tr: 2. **Peso.** Como a habitação é muito grande, uma pequena variação mensal pode mover o núcleo do CPI de forma perceptível.

segments.src: If you rent, your experience may differ from the average, especially if your lease just renewed.
segments.tr: Se você aluga, sua experiência pode ser diferente da média, especialmente se seu contrato acabou de ser renovado.

segments.src: If you own a home with a fixed-rate mortgage, your housing payment may barely change even while the index's shelter component rises.
segments.tr: Se você possui uma casa com hipoteca de taxa fixa, seu pagamento de moradia pode quase não mudar, mesmo enquanto o componente de habitação do índice sobe.

segments.src: ### Food
segments.tr: ### Alimentação

segments.src: Food is split into "food at home" (groceries) and "food away from home" (restaurants and takeout).
segments.tr: A alimentação é dividida em "alimentação em casa" (supermercado) e "alimentação fora de casa" (restaurantes e delivery).

segments.src: Grocery prices can be volatile, driven by weather, animal disease, transportation costs, and global supply.
segments.tr: Os preços dos supermercados podem ser voláteis, impulsionados pelo clima, doenças animais, custos de transporte e oferta global.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to move more steadily because they include labor and rent costs.
segments.tr: Os preços dos restaurantes tendem a se mover de forma mais estável porque incluem custos de mão de obra e aluguel.

segments.src: ### Energy
segments.tr: ### Energia

segments.src: Energy covers gasoline, electricity, natural gas, and fuel oil.
segments.tr: A energia cobre gasolina, eletricidade, gás natural e óleo combustível.

segments.src: Gasoline often drives the largest month-to-month swings in headline inflation.
segments.tr: A gasolina geralmente impulsiona as maiores oscilações mês a mês na inflação geral.

segments.src: A drop at the pump can pull the headline number down even if nothing else has changed, and a spike can do the opposite.
segments.tr: Uma queda na bomba pode puxar o número geral para baixo mesmo se nada mais tiver mudado, e um pico pode fazer o oposto.

segments.src: ### Core goods and core services
segments.tr: ### Bens do núcleo e serviços do núcleo

segments.src: Within core, economists often separate **goods** (cars, furniture, apparel, appliances) from **services** (medical care, insurance, transportation services, recreation, and shelter).
segments.tr: Dentro do núcleo, os economistas costumam separar **bens** (carros, móveis, vestuário, eletrodomésticos) de **serviços** (cuidados médicos, seguros, serviços de transporte, recreação e habitação).

segments.src: Goods prices respond strongly to supply chains and tariffs, while services tend to be tied to wages and move more slowly.
segments.tr: Os preços dos bens reagem fortemente às cadeias de suprimentos e tarifas, enquanto os serviços tendem a estar atrelados aos salários e se movem mais lentamente.

segments.src: A report in which "supercore" services (core services excluding housing) stays elevated may signal different pressures than one driven by goods.
segments.tr: Um relatório no qual os serviços do "supernúcleo" (serviços do núcleo excluindo habitação) permanecem elevados pode sinalizar pressões diferentes daquele impulsionado por bens.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report in Five Steps
segments.tr: ## Como Ler o Relatório em Cinco Passos

segments.src: 1. **Check the monthly change first.** The monthly figure, seasonally adjusted, shows the latest momentum. The annual (year-over-year) figure covers twelve months and can be influenced by what happened a year ago, a quirk known as the *base effect*.
segments.tr: 1. **Verifique primeiro a variação mensal.** O número mensal, ajustado sazonalmente, mostra o momento mais recente. O número anual (ano a ano) cobre doze meses e pode ser influenciado pelo que aconteceu há um ano, um detalhe conhecido como *efeito base*.

segments.src: 2. **Compare headline and core.** A wide gap usually points to food or energy as the cause.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare o geral e o núcleo.** Uma grande diferença geralmente aponta para alimentos ou energia como a causa.

segments.src: 3. **Look at shelter.** Is it rising or easing, and how much of the core change does it explain?
segments.tr: 3. **Olhe para a habitação.** Está subindo ou desacelerando, e quanto da variação do núcleo ela explica?

segments.src: 4. **Look beyond the headline.** Goods, services excluding shelter, and categories you personally buy tell you more than a single number.
segments.tr: 4. **Olhe além do número geral.** Bens, serviços excluindo habitação e categorias que você compra pessoalmente dizem mais do que um único número.

segments.src: 5. **Compare with expectations.** Markets react to the gap between the reported figure and forecasts, not just the figure itself. A "hot" or "cool" label usually means above or below the consensus estimate, and the numbers are often revised or rounded in ways that make small misses look bigger than they are.
segments.tr: 5. **Compare com as expectativas.** Os mercados reagem à diferença entre o número divulgado e as previsões, não apenas ao número em si. Um rótulo de "aquecido" ou "frio" geralmente significa acima ou abaixo da estimativa de consenso, e os números são frequentemente revisados ou arredondados de maneiras que fazem pequenas divergências parecerem maiores do que são.

segments.src: For a smoother view, some analysts follow alternative measures such as the Cleveland Fed's median and trimmed-mean CPI, which reduce the influence of extreme price moves.
segments.tr: Para uma visão mais suave, alguns analistas acompanham medidas alternativas, como a mediana e a média aparada do CPI do Fed de Cleveland, que reduzem a influência de movimentos extremos de preços.

segments.src: ## Why the Official Number Can Miss What You Pay
segments.tr: ## Por Que o Número Oficial Pode Não Refletir o Que Você Paga

segments.src: Even a well-built index describes an average that no real household matches exactly.
segments.tr: Mesmo um índice bem construído descreve uma média que nenhuma família real atinge exatamente.

segments.src: Several reasons explain the mismatch:
segments.tr: Vários motivos explicam essa discrepância:

segments.src: - **Your basket is different.** The CPI weights categories by typical spending. If you commute long distances, have young children, pay for private insurance, or rent in a fast-moving market, your mix may lean toward faster-rising items.
segments.tr: - **Sua cesta é diferente.** O CPI pondera as categorias pelos gastos típicos. Se você percorre longas distâncias para trabalhar, tem filhos pequenos, paga por seguro privado ou aluga em um mercado de movimentação rápida, sua combinação de gastos pode tender para itens que sobem mais rápido.

segments.src: - **Prices vs. inflation.** Inflation is a rate of change. When inflation slows from, say, a high rate to a lower one, prices are still rising, just more slowly. Price *levels* generally do not fall back, so everyday costs can still feel high long after the annual rate has eased.
segments.tr: - **Preços vs. inflação.** A inflação é uma taxa de variação. Quando a inflação desacelera de, digamos, uma taxa alta para uma mais baixa, os preços ainda estão subindo, apenas mais lentamente. Os *níveis* de preços geralmente não caem de volta, então os custos do dia a dia ainda podem parecer altos muito depois de a taxa anual ter aliviado.

segments.src: - **Frequent purchases loom larger.** People notice gas, eggs, and coffee more than they notice the price of a washing machine bought once every ten years. Frequent, visible purchases shape perception more than their budget share would suggest.
segments.tr: - **Compras frequentes têm maior peso perceptivo.** As pessoas notam mais a gasolina, os ovos e o café do que o preço de uma máquina de lavar comprada uma vez a cada dez anos. Compras frequentes e visíveis moldam a percepção mais do que a sua fatia no orçamento sugeriria.

segments.src: - **Quality adjustments.** The BLS adjusts prices when product quality changes, such as a phone with a better camera. This is intended to separate pure price changes from improvements, but consumers may not feel they are getting the extra value.
segments.tr: - **Ajustes de qualidade.** O BLS ajusta os preços quando a qualidade do produto muda, como um telefone com uma câmera melhor. Isso se destina a separar puras mudanças de preço de melhorias, mas os consumidores podem não sentir que estão recebendo esse valor extra.

segments.src: - **Shrinkflation and substitution.** Smaller packages at the same price are captured in the unit-price data, but the index also assumes consumers shift to alternatives when relative prices change. Not everyone can or wants to switch.
segments.tr: - **Reduflação e substituição.** Embalagens menores pelo mesmo preço são capturadas nos dados de preço unitário, mas o índice também pressupõe que os consumidores mudam para alternativas quando os preços relativos mudam. Nem todo mundo pode ou quer trocar.

segments.src: - **Regional differences.** National averages mask local conditions. Housing, utilities, and insurance costs vary widely by metro area.
segments.tr: - **Diferenças regionais.** As médias nacionais mascaram as condições locais. Custos de moradia, serviços públicos e seguros variam amplamente por área metropolitana.

segments.src: - **Income and wage timing.** If your pay rises slower than prices, you feel the squeeze regardless of what the index says; if it rises faster, the squeeze may feel milder.
segments.tr: - **Renda e momento dos salários.** Se o seu salário sobe mais devagar que os preços, você sente o aperto independentemente do que o índice diz; se sobe mais rápido, o aperto pode parecer mais brando.

segments.src: It feeds into several things that touch daily life:
segments.tr: CPI memengaruhi beberapa hal yang menyentuh kehidupan sehari-hari:

segments.src: - **Interest-rate expectations.** The Federal Reserve targets 2% inflation, measured by a related gauge called the PCE price index. Markets still treat the CPI, which arrives earlier, as a key signal for where rates may go. Rates, in turn, influence mortgages, car loans, credit cards, and savings yields.
segments.tr: - **Ekspektasi suku bunga.** Federal Reserve menargetkan inflasi 2%, yang diukur dengan indikator terkait yang disebut indeks harga PCE. Pasar tetap memperlakukan CPI, yang dirilis lebih awal, sebagai sinyal utama arah suku bunga. Suku bunga pada akhirnya memengaruhi hipotek, pinjaman mobil, kartu kredit, dan imbal hasil tabungan.

segments.src: - **Social Security cost-of-living adjustments (COLAs).** The annual COLA is based on the CPI-W, a variant covering urban wage earners and clerical workers. It compares the third-quarter average with the prior year's third quarter.
segments.tr: - **Penyesuaian biaya hidup (COLA) Jaminan Sosial.** COLA tahunan didasarkan pada CPI-W, varian yang mencakup pekerja penerima upah perkotaan dan pekerja klerikal. Ini membandingkan rata-rata kuartal ketiga dengan kuartal ketiga tahun sebelumnya.

segments.src: - **Wages and contracts.** Some labor agreements, leases, and benefit programs reference CPI changes, and inflation figures shape wage negotiations.
segments.tr: - **Upah dan kontrak.** Beberapa perjanjian kerja, sewa, dan program tunjangan mengacu pada perubahan CPI, dan angka inflasi membentuk negosiasi upah.

segments.src: - **Tax and program parameters.** Federal income tax brackets and certain benefit thresholds are adjusted each year using a CPI-based measure.
segments.tr: - **Parameter pajak dan program.** Kurung pajak penghasilan federal dan ambang batas tunjangan tertentu disesuaikan setiap tahun menggunakan ukuran berbasis CPI.

segments.src: ## Headline vs. Core: What's the Difference?
segments.tr: ## Headline vs. Core: Apa Perbedaannya?

segments.src: **Headline CPI** covers everything in the basket.
segments.tr: **Headline CPI** mencakup semua hal dalam keranjang.

segments.src: **Core CPI** removes food and energy.
segments.tr: **Core CPI** mengecualikan makanan dan energi.

segments.src: Those two categories tend to swing sharply because of weather, crop conditions, geopolitical events, and oil-market shifts.
segments.tr: Kedua kategori tersebut cenderung berfluktuasi tajam karena cuaca, kondisi panen, peristiwa geopolitik, dan pergeseran pasar minyak.

segments.src: Stripping them out can give a steadier read on underlying trends, which is why many economists and policymakers watch core closely.
segments.tr: Mengecualikan keduanya dapat memberikan gambaran yang lebih stabil tentang tren mendasar, itulah sebabnya banyak ekonom dan pembuat kebijakan mengawasi angka core dengan cermat.

segments.src: Core is not "the real inflation" and headline is not "the fake one."
segments.tr: Core bukanlah "inflasi yang asli" dan headline bukanlah "inflasi yang palsu."

segments.src: They answer different questions:
segments.tr: Keduanya menjawab pertanyaan yang berbeda:

segments.src: - Headline asks: *How much more does the typical household's total spending cost?*
segments.tr: - Headline bertanya: *Berapa biaya tambahan untuk total pengeluaran rumah tangga tipikal?*

segments.src: - Core asks: *Is price pressure broadening and persisting beyond volatile items?*
segments.tr: - Core bertanya: *Apakah tekanan harga meluas dan bertahan di luar barang-barang yang volatil?*

segments.src: Food and energy are not optional for most families, so a core reading that looks calm can sit alongside a headline reading that feels painful, and the reverse can also happen.
segments.tr: Makanan dan energi bukanlah pilihan (opsional) bagi sebagian besar keluarga, sehingga angka core yang terlihat tenang bisa berdampingan dengan angka headline yang terasa memberatkan, dan hal sebaliknya juga bisa terjadi.

segments.src: ## The Big Components, One by One
segments.tr: ## Komponen-Komponen Utama, Satu per Satu

segments.src: ### Shelter
segments.tr: ### Tempat Tinggal (Shelter)

segments.src: Shelter is the largest piece of the index, typically around one-third of the overall CPI and a larger share of core.
segments.tr: Shelter adalah bagian terbesar dari indeks ini, biasanya mencakup sekitar satu pertiga dari keseluruhan CPI dan porsi yang lebih besar dari core.

segments.src: It includes rent of primary residences and "owners' equivalent rent" (OER), which estimates what homeowners would pay to rent their own homes.
segments.tr: Ini mencakup sewa tempat tinggal utama dan "sewa setara pemilik" (owners' equivalent rent/OER), yang memperkirakan berapa biaya yang akan dibayar pemilik rumah jika menyewa rumah mereka sendiri.

segments.src: It does not directly track home purchase prices or mortgage payments.
segments.tr: Ini tidak memantau harga pembelian rumah atau pembayaran hipotek secara langsung.

segments.src: Two features matter when reading the report:
segments.tr: Dua fitur penting saat membaca laporan:

segments.src: 1. **Lag.** Rent data are collected from a rotating sample, with each housing unit surveyed only periodically. As a result, the CPI can reflect changes in new-lease market rents months after private rent trackers show them.
segments.tr: 1. **Jeda Waktu (Lag).** Data sewa dikumpulkan dari sampel bergilir, dengan setiap unit hunian disurvei secara berkala. Akibatnya, CPI baru mencerminkan perubahan harga sewa pasar untuk kontrak baru beberapa bulan setelah pelacak sewa swasta menunjukkannya.

segments.src: 2. **Weight.** Because shelter is so big, a small monthly change can move core CPI noticeably.
segments.tr: 2. **Bobot (Weight).** Karena bobot shelter sangat besar, perubahan bulanan yang kecil dapat menggerakkan core CPI secara signifikan.

segments.src: If you rent, your experience may differ from the average, especially if your lease just renewed.
segments.tr: Jika Anda menyewa, pengalaman Anda mungkin berbeda dari rata-rata, terutama jika masa sewa Anda baru saja diperbarui.

segments.src: If you own a home with a fixed-rate mortgage, your housing payment may barely change even while the index's shelter component rises.
segments.tr: Jika Anda memiliki rumah dengan hipotek suku bunga tetap, pembayaran hunian Anda mungkin hampir tidak berubah meskipun komponen shelter dalam indeks meningkat.

segments.src: ### Food
segments.tr: ### Makanan

segments.src: Food is split into "food at home" (groceries) and "food away from home" (restaurants and takeout).
segments.tr: Makanan dibagi menjadi "makanan di rumah" (bahan makanan) dan "makanan di luar rumah" (restoran dan makanan siap saji).

segments.src: Grocery prices can be volatile, driven by weather, animal disease, transportation costs, and global supply.
segments.tr: Harga bahan makanan bisa volatil, didorong oleh faktor cuaca, penyakit hewan, biaya transportasi, dan pasokan global.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to move more steadily because they include labor and rent costs.
segments.tr: Harga restoran cenderung bergerak lebih stabil karena mencakup biaya tenaga kerja dan sewa.

segments.src: ### Energy
segments.tr: ### Energi

segments.src: Energy covers gasoline, electricity, natural gas, and fuel oil.
segments.tr: Energi mencakup bensin, listrik, gas alam, dan minyak pemanas.

segments.src: Gasoline often drives the largest month-to-month swings in headline inflation.
segments.tr: Bensin sering kali menjadi pendorong fluktuasi bulanan terbesar pada inflasi headline.

segments.src: A drop at the pump can pull the headline number down even if nothing else has changed, and a spike can do the opposite.
segments.tr: Penurunan harga di SPBU dapat menarik angka headline turun meskipun tidak ada hal lain yang berubah, dan lonjakan harga dapat berdampak sebaliknya.

segments.src: ### Core goods and core services
segments.tr: ### Barang Inti dan Jasa Inti

segments.src: Within core, economists often separate **goods** (cars, furniture, apparel, appliances) from **services** (medical care, insurance, transportation services, recreation, and shelter).
segments.tr: Dalam core, para ekonom sering memisahkan **barang** (mobil, furnitur, pakaian, peralatan rumah tangga) dari **jasa** (layanan kesehatan, asuransi, jasa transportasi, rekreasi, dan shelter).

segments.src: Goods prices respond strongly to supply chains and tariffs, while services tend to be tied to wages and move more slowly.
segments.tr: Harga barang sangat merespons rantai pasokan dan tarif, sedangkan jasa cenderung terikat pada upah dan bergerak lebih lambat.

segments.src: A report in which "supercore" services (core services excluding housing) stays elevated may signal different pressures than one driven by goods.
segments.tr: Laporan di mana jasa "supercore" (jasa inti tidak termasuk perumahan) tetap tinggi dapat mengindikasikan tekanan yang berbeda dibandingkan laporan yang didorong oleh barang.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report in Five Steps
segments.tr: ## Cara Membaca Laporan dalam Lima Langkah

segments.src: 1. **Check the monthly change first.** The monthly figure, seasonally adjusted, shows the latest momentum. The annual (year-over-year) figure covers twelve months and can be influenced by what happened a year ago, a quirk known as the *base effect*.
segments.tr: 1. **Periksa perubahan bulanan terlebih dahulu.** Angka bulanan yang disesuaikan secara musiman menunjukkan momentum terkini. Angka tahunan (year-over-year) mencakup 12 bulan dan dapat dipengaruhi oleh apa yang terjadi satu tahun lalu, sebuah fenomena yang dikenal sebagai *base effect* (efek basis).

segments.src: 2. **Compare headline and core.** A wide gap usually points to food or energy as the cause.
segments.tr: 2. **Bandingkan headline dan core.** Kesenjangan yang lebar biasanya mengarah pada makanan atau energi sebagai penyebabnya.

segments.src: 3. **Look at shelter.** Is it rising or easing, and how much of the core change does it explain?
segments.tr: 3. **Lihat komponen shelter.** Apakah angkanya naik atau mereda, dan seberapa besar kontribusinya terhadap perubahan core?

segments.src: 4. **Look beyond the headline.** Goods, services excluding shelter, and categories you personally buy tell you more than a single number.
segments.tr: 4. **Lihat lebih jauh dari sekadar headline.** Barang, jasa tidak termasuk shelter, dan kategori yang Anda beli secara pribadi memberi tahu Anda lebih banyak hal daripada sekadar satu angka tunggal.

segments.src: 5. **Compare with expectations.** Markets react to the gap between the reported figure and forecasts, not just the figure itself. A "hot" or "cool" label usually means above or below the consensus estimate, and the numbers are often revised or rounded in ways that make small misses look bigger than they are.
segments.tr: 5. **Bandingkan dengan ekspektasi.** Pasar bereaksi terhadap kesenjangan antara angka yang dilaporkan dan perkiraan, bukan hanya angka itu sendiri. Label "panas" atau "dingin" biasanya berarti di atas atau di bawah estimasi konsensus, dan angka-angka tersebut sering kali direvisi atau dibulatkan dengan cara yang membuat celah kecil terlihat lebih besar dari yang sebenarnya.

segments.src: For a smoother view, some analysts follow alternative measures such as the Cleveland Fed's median and trimmed-mean CPI, which reduce the influence of extreme price moves.
segments.tr: Untuk pandangan yang lebih halus, beberapa analis mengikuti ukuran alternatif seperti median dan trimmed-mean CPI dari Cleveland Fed, yang mengurangi pengaruh pergerakan harga yang ekstrem.

segments.src: ## Why the Official Number Can Miss What You Pay
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Angka Resmi Bisa Berbeda dari yang Anda Bayar

segments.src: Even a well-built index describes an average that no real household matches exactly.
segments.tr: Bahkan indeks yang dirancang dengan baik pun menggambarkan rata-rata yang tidak cocok secara persis dengan rumah tangga nyata mana pun.

segments.src: Several reasons explain the mismatch:
segments.tr: Beberapa alasan menjelaskan ketidakcocokan tersebut:

segments.src: - **Your basket is different.** The CPI weights categories by typical spending. If you commute long distances, have young children, pay for private insurance, or rent in a fast-moving market, your mix may lean toward faster-rising items.
segments.tr: - **Keranjang belanja Anda berbeda.** CPI membobot kategori berdasarkan pengeluaran tipikal. Jika Anda bepergian jarak jauh untuk bekerja, memiliki anak kecil, membayar asuransi swasta, atau menyewa di pasar yang bergerak cepat, proporsi pengeluaran Anda mungkin lebih condong ke barang-barang yang harganya naik lebih cepat.

segments.src: - **Prices vs. inflation.** Inflation is a rate of change. When inflation slows from, say, a high rate to a lower one, prices are still rising, just more slowly. Price *levels* generally do not fall back, so everyday costs can still feel high long after the annual rate has eased.
segments.tr: - **Harga vs. inflasi.** Inflasi adalah laju perubahan. Ketika inflasi melambat dari, misalnya, tingkat yang tinggi ke tingkat yang lebih rendah, harga-harga sebenarnya masih naik, hanya saja lebih lambat. *Tingkat* harga umumnya tidak turun kembali, sehingga biaya sehari-hari masih terasa tinggi lama setelah laju tahunan mereda.

segments.src: - **Frequent purchases loom larger.** People notice gas, eggs, and coffee more than they notice the price of a washing machine bought once every ten years. Frequent, visible purchases shape perception more than their budget share would suggest.
segments.tr: - **Pembelian rutin lebih menyita perhatian.** Orang lebih memperhatikan harga bensin, telur, dan kopi daripada harga mesin cuci yang dibeli 10 tahun sekali. Pembelian yang sering dan terlihat lebih membentuk persepsi dibandingkan porsinya dalam anggaran.

segments.src: - **Quality adjustments.** The BLS adjusts prices when product quality changes, such as a phone with a better camera. This is intended to separate pure price changes from improvements, but consumers may not feel they are getting the extra value.
segments.tr: - **Penyesuaian kualitas.** BLS menyesuaikan harga ketika kualitas produk berubah, seperti ponsel dengan kamera yang lebih baik. Ini bertujuan untuk memisahkan perubahan harga murni dari peningkatan kualitas, tetapi konsumen mungkin tidak merasa mendapatkan nilai ekstra tersebut.

segments.src: - **Shrinkflation and substitution.** Smaller packages at the same price are captured in the unit-price data, but the index also assumes consumers shift to alternatives when relative prices change. Not everyone can or wants to switch.
segments.tr: - **Shrinkflation dan substitusi.** Kemasan yang lebih kecil dengan harga yang sama tercatat dalam data harga per unit, tetapi indeks juga mengasumsikan konsumen beralih ke alternatif lain ketika harga relatif berubah. Tidak semua orang bisa atau ingin beralih.

segments.src: - **Regional differences.** National averages mask local conditions. Housing, utilities, and insurance costs vary widely by metro area.
segments.tr: - **Perbedaan regional.** Rata-rata nasional menyembunyikan kondisi lokal. Biaya perumahan, utilitas, dan asuransi sangat bervariasi menurut wilayah metropolitan.

segments.src: - **Income and wage timing.** If your pay rises slower than prices, you feel the squeeze regardless of what the index says; if it rises faster, the squeeze may feel milder.
segments.tr: - **Waktu penyesuaian pendapatan dan upah.** Jika gaji Anda naik lebih lambat daripada kenaikan harga, Anda akan merasakan tekanannya terlepas dari apa yang dikatakan indeks; jika naik lebih cepat, tekanannya mungkin terasa lebih ringan.

segments.src: ## A Practical Way to Build Your Own Inflation Read
segments.tr: ## Cara Praktis Menilai Inflasi Pribadi Anda

segments.src: - List your top spending categories and what you paid for each over the past year.
segments.tr: - Buat daftar kategori pengeluaran utama Anda dan berapa yang Anda bayar untuk masing-masing kategori selama sebulan/setahun terakhir.

segments.src: - Compare those with the matching CPI components, which the BLS publishes in detail, including regional tables.
segments.tr: - Bandingkan dengan komponen CPI yang sesuai, yang dipublikasikan secara rinci oleh BLS, termasuk tabel regional.

segments.src: - Note which costs are fixed (a fixed-rate mortgage, a locked lease) and which are exposed (groceries, fuel, insurance renewals).
segments.tr: - Catat biaya mana yang bersifat tetap (hipotek suku bunga tetap, sewa yang terkunci) dan mana yang rentan fluktuasi (bahan makanan, bahan bakar, pembaharuan asuransi).

segments.src: - Use the result for budgeting and for conversations about pay, rather than relying on a single national percentage.
segments.tr: - Gunakan hasilnya untuk penganggaran dan negosiasi gaji, alih-alih hanya mengandalkan satu persentase nasional.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The CPI is a valuable, carefully constructed tool, but it is an average of a basket, not a bill of your own.
segments.tr: CPI adalah alat yang berharga dan disusun dengan cermat, tetapi ini adalah rata-rata dari sekeranjang barang/jasa, bukan tagihan pribadi Anda.

segments.src: Headline inflation tells you how much the full basket moved; core inflation helps you see how persistent the underlying pressure is; and shelter, food, and energy each tell a different part of the story.
segments.tr: Inflasi headline memberi tahu Anda seberapa besar seluruh keranjang bergerak; inflasi core membantu Anda melihat seberapa persisten tekanan mendasar tersebut; dan shelter, makanan, serta energi masing-masing menyampaikan bagian cerita yang berbeda.

segments.src: Reading the next report with those distinctions in mind will help you separate noise from trend, and explain why the data and your wallet sometimes seem to disagree.
segments.tr: Membaca laporan berikutnya dengan memahami perbedaan-perbedaan tersebut akan membantu Anda memisahkan kebisingan (noise) dari tren, dan menjelaskan mengapa data dan dompet Anda terkadang tampak tidak sejalan.
